description:
Request for Information 
Telehealth, Scheduling, & Mobile Platform Services (TSMPS)
VA-26-00049589
The purpose of this posting is to document the correct RFI response due date, as it was incorrectly documented in the initial posting. Responses are due no later than March 17, 2026 at 11AM EST via email to Sarah MacArthur, Contract Specialist at Sarah.MacArthur@va.gov and Matthew Newell, Contracting Officer at Matthew.Newell@va.gov.  Please note  Telehealth, Scheduling, & Mobile Platform Services (TSMPS)  in the subject line of your response.  Mark your response as  Proprietary Information  if the information is considered business sensitive.  The email file size shall not exceed 5 MB.
